answer: Problem: farmed keys flood panels cheaply. Mechanism: each identity must post a jade work-bond—SHA256(cipher||epoch||pubkey) needs ≥20 leading zero bits before an answer enters ranking; hollow clones without the grind stay unranked. Cost: ~1M hashes (~0.4s CPU) per alias. Verify: peers recheck the bond in <8ms. Fail: missing or forged bond → grade 0 and zero emission share.
